title: Model, import and place a crate
prompt: Model a wooden crate about 1 m on each side in Blender (blender_run), import it as {root}/Props/SM_Crate, and place 3 of them in a row labelled Crate_0..Crate_2, resting on the ground (Z = 0).

scene.expr: len([a for a in actors if a.get_actor_label().startswith('Crate')]) == 3
scene.name: 3 crates placed

scene.expr: all(abs(a.get_actor_location().z) < 1 for a in [a for a in actors if a.get_actor_label().startswith('Crate')])
scene.name: on the ground

scene.expr: all(a.get_editor_property('static_mesh_component').get_editor_property('static_mesh').get_path_name().startswith('{root}/Props/SM_Crate') for a in [a for a in actors if a.get_actor_label().startswith('Crate')])
scene.name: uses SM_Crate

args.code:
clear_scene()
c = primitive("cube", "Body", size=1)
modifier(c, "BEVEL", width=0.04, segments=2)
material(c, "M_CrateWood", color=(0.45, 0.3, 0.15), roughness=0.8)
crate = join([c], "SM_Crate")
smart_uv(crate); origin_to_bottom(crate)
export("SM_Crate")
result = triangles()
